stdinBoundary.sourceSupportedInference: With retained exact source and the expected unique EOF_REQUEST_COUNT error, startup guards and metadata import returned and the empty-input loop reached its final count check. stdinBoundary.handlerOrReplyQualification: No supplied request, handler execution, reply or sidecar is established. The empty-input source path does not invoke _handleLine.

eofHandshakeSourceFinding.finding: Each complete LF-terminated line is validated, handled, saved and written to stdout inside the chunk/line loop before EOF. The parent closes stdin only after receiving the sole complete reply. This control flow does not require EOF to produce that reply.
eofHandshakeSourceFinding.limits: Source finding only; R4 supplied no request and does not establish where R2 reached.

proposedNextDiagnostic.scope: One fresh request-phase diagnostic observing the existing full LOCAL Python parent and descendants; preserve all original authority checks and native command contracts.
prerequisites: Preserve R1/R2 namespaces, byte pins, original failures and R4 diagnostic evidence.

Create a fresh worker runId/outputRoot and Q-JS/Q-RUST output paths; keep fixed candidate, original6276-byte materialized request, expected13-key replies, current449 source and prerequisite authority unchanged.
Obtain independent actual whole-core configuration QA/security acceptance, final configuration approval and fresh exact root LOCAL release.
Independently review exact outer observation/capture configuration, source pins, privacy, output caps, ownership and cleanup before activation.

request.inputMeaning: The original one-line materialized request; no request sent to an old binding/output namespace.

observationPlan: Externally trace the reviewed outer LOCAL Python invocation and descendants, leaving fixed Python-to-Node/native argv and six-variable native environment unchanged.

Retain execve/openat/read/pread64/readv/close and, if independently accepted, write/writev observations with every read/write buffer rendered as raw pointer/count arguments; never dump input buffers, secrets or environment values.

Use fresh exclusive0600 bounded trace/stdout/stderr outputs and retain overflow, incomplete capture, timeout, force, original error and cleanup facts. Raw trace overflow remains unqualified; do not silently increase a cap.

Correlate actual pipe write/read lengths, later closure-order sequences, dependency-file opens, native-reply sidecar creation, stdout writes and retained native lifecycle receipts. Syscall-order attribution remains source-supported unless direct independently reviewed phase evidence exists.
acceptance: Exact request bytes and fresh authority/config/release lineage retained; native argv/environment and mandatory gate checks unchanged.
Actual observed request write/read and complete or interrupted source-operation sequence localized without inferring internal progress solely from empty stderr.
Any earliest deadline/refusal, forced cleanup and skipped Rust job remain visible.
Independent QA/security review of the actual raw trace, custody, lifecycle and source-supported interpretation before any new qualification claim.
prohibitions: No source optimization, validator caching, prewarming, changed timer anchors or deadline increases for a pass.
No request replay into old R2 binding/output that could create an old native sidecar.
No canonical PASS, blocker closure, SDK, deployment, profile adoption or merge follows from diagnostic completion.
limits: Tracing overhead can alter timing and does not reproduce untraced R2 performance.
Even a MATCHED declaration or zero outer exit needs complete independent result review; diagnostic records do not automatically complete the blocked experiment.
